request: Add AIRO lettering to round 2 concept 3, preserving the approved swift symbol

variants.name: 가로형
variants.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Edit the supplied approved AIRO swift-bird symbol into a finished combination logo that includes the brand name.
Reference role: the attached image is the exact approved symbol. Preserve the bird's distinctive silhouette, banking angle, crescent wings, integrated head, forked tail, all internal negative spaces, and ivory color. You may only scale and position it to compose the logo. Do not redesign, mirror, simplify or add details to the bird.
Exact wordmark text: "AIRO" — precisely four uppercase letters A I R O, in that order.
Wordmark design: refined custom contemporary humanist sans-serif, medium weight, open and clearly readable. Give the R leg and A diagonal a subtle sweep that harmonizes with the bird. Balanced optical kerning and restrained tracking; confident and understated, with enough weight to hold up beside the solid bird. No literal wings or birds substituted for letters.
Color and finish: flat solid ivory #F3F1EA symbol and lettering on a uniform opaque near-black #0A0A0A background. Crisp edges and flat color, no glow, halo, gradient, texture, shadow, 3D, bevel or lighting.
Output: one finished standalone logo arrangement only. No presentation board, extra versions, mockup, border, slogan, Korean text, descriptive caption, trademark symbol, watermark or additional graphics.
Composition: wide landscape canvas, approximately 2:1. Place the bird on the left and AIRO on its right as one centered horizontal lockup. The bird is roughly 1.55 times the uppercase letter height. Align their optical centers, leaving a purposeful but not excessive gap. The full lockup occupies approximately 78 percent of the canvas width, with generous even outer margins. Carefully balance the visual weight so the bird and name feel like one brand.
